insights: The palette evokes a raw, unstyled web aesthetic by using the default browser #0000EE blue not just for every interactive link and card, but for the main brand wordmark itself.
Surface hierarchy is extremely flat; the page relies on the white background, using light gray fills exclusively to define touch targets like buttons and inputs rather than broad page sections.
Form inputs are distinctly styled with structural gray borders, rejecting borderless modern input trends to maintain clear, utilitarian usability.
